title: Naturality of common-stage evaluation on permitted Hom pairs
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be an algebraic closure, and let $W$ be a scheme on whose residue fields $\ell$ is invertible. Use the actual common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], its tensor functor $T$ and permitted internal-Hom functor $H$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the normalized partial closed structure [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]. For any permitted pairs $P,Q$ and any pair morphism $g:P\to Q$, evaluation satisfies $T(H(g),1_{Q_1})\,\mathrm{ev}_Q=T(1_{H(P)},g_1)\,\mathrm{ev}_P\,g_2$, where $g_1:Q_1\to P_1$ is the unop of the first component and $g_2:P_2\to Q_2$ is the second component. This is an equality in the actual common-stage category; no perfectness or invertibility of $g$ is assumed.

proof.text: Represent the two components of the pair morphism at one finite field large enough for both permitted pairs, their Hom objects and the tensor sources. The representative formulas identify common tensor and Hom with the rational operations, conjugated by the recorded comparisons.

Rational evaluation is the localized integral inverse transpose of identity. Integral evaluation is the ordinary derived Hom counit transported through completion, hence is natural in the target and dinatural in the source. Expanding arbitrary localized maps into sums of pure tensors and using bilinearity gives the rational equation. The prescribed common inverse-transpose normalization carries it to the representatives at the common field.

Cancel inverse tensor and Hom comparisons; the finite-stage composites are equal. Taking their classes proves the asserted equation. Tower coherence makes the equality independent of enlargement and representatives.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageEvaluation_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField x)]
    (P Q : (commonStageHomPairs l Ω W).FullSubcategory) (g : P ⟶ Q) :
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω W).map g) (𝟙 Q.obj.1.unop)) ≫
      (podCommonClosed l Ω W).evaluation Q =
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω W).obj P)) g.hom.1.unop) ≫
      (podCommonClosed l Ω W).evaluation P ≫ g.hom.2
